text: Hardened the full court for shared-worktree and cross-runtime evidence. Every phase now verifies source identity and Java/Node/Python/NumPy environment before and after execution; the fingerprint covers all modules including laws and browser tests; JDK home is explicit and resolved executable identities plus NumPy BLAS/SIMD build are recorded. Added JVM/Scala.js laws and guarded browser correctness phases, with browser ownership audits guaranteed before and after even on failure. Phase logs are checksummed as proof artifacts. Node timing validation independently recomputes medians and RSD from raw samples and marks unstable family/row comparisons. Expanded the JVM/NumPy public matrix from two sizes to 64/256/1024; NumPy semantic smoke emitted all 237 rows. Reworked macOS host qualification to distinguish stale compressed memory from active paging using memory-pressure freedom, pagein/decompression rates, and swap/pageout deltas. Verification: 28/28 benchmark Python tests, ruff check/format, py_compile, dry-run/environment capture, 237-row NumPy signature generation, and git diff --check all pass. No long timings started.
